title: mint trees
tagline: Mint trees makes planting trees programmable. We enable web3 projects to integrate planting trees easily. #1swap1tree #1post1tree #1mint1tree #1booking1tree
description: Idea we tried to implement today was to offer a simple UI Alice could use to fund the planting of trees around the globe. We got stuck along the way. Learned a lot. Got a working nftFactory going, that sorta thing. Thanks! We we also thinking about maybe a DAO which produced tree's as a factor of it's existance. But didn't have time to work on that idea. We spent a sold weekend hacking. THANKS again.
how_its_made: We started from the NFT tutorials on buildspace. We didn't do anything fancy from there. We kinda got stuck. Tons of great support from the folks in the tables around us. Was a blast! Perfect experience. Thanks!  Hardhat was cool. JS is a bit of a wild ride. We might be interested to try different setups in the future.
